case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment's caption.

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant was charged; the accomplice is described but not charged as an accused.

accused_gender.reason: Appellant is male, referred to as 'he' throughout.

accused_age.reason: High Court noted the accused is a young man of 33 years.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment shows he owned a farm house and engaged PW-1 as labourer, but never states his occupation.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is female (post-mortem describes female body; deceased is the daughter).

victim_age.reason: Judgment states the deceased was aged about 22 years.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the appellant-accused engaged him as a labourer in his farm house
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment never describes accused as a stranger; the relationship between accused and victim is not stated.

offence_category.quote: committed rape on her and, thereafter, the appellant-accused assaulted the girl by throttling her neck
offence_category.reason: Category omits the rape element, which is equally charged and upheld.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment charges and upholds Sections 302 and 376 IPC.

weapon.correct_value: Dao seized from farm house; accused and accomplice carried Khukri; victim died by throttling
weapon.quote: seized one bed sheet, a sporting and a 'dao' from the farm house
weapon.reason: Judgment mentions a dao and Khukri weapons, not 'none mentioned'.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness (PW-1), corroborative witnesses (PW-2, PW-3, PW-4, co-villagers), medical evidence, seized articles
evidence_type.quote: the evidence of PW-1 ... is reliable and is corroborated by PW-2, father of the deceased and the doctor (PW-9)
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial evidence is not identified; corroborative family/villager testimony and seized articles are omitted.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Heinous crime of rape and murder; dead body thrown in a place surrounded by bushes and shrubs
aggravating_circumstances.quote: considering the heinous crime of committing rape and murder and throwing the dead body in a place surrounded by bushes and shrubs
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment expressly identifies aggravating factors, contrary to 'None noted'.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Accused's young age (33 years); case not 'rarest of rare'
mitigating_circumstances.quote: the accused is a young man of 33 years of age and also finding that the case does not come under the purview of the 'rarest of rare' category
mitigating_circumstances.reason: High Court relied on age and rarest-of-rare finding as mitigation, contrary to 'None noted'.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted, death for s.302 and life RI for s.376, matching the judgment.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction, commuted death to life, and reduced s.376 sentence to 7 years.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so the accused stands convicted.

offence_finally_established.reason: Rape and murder conviction upheld by both High Court and Supreme Court.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Life imprisonment for s.302 (commuted from death); 7 years for s.376
imprisonment_type.quote: the High Court sentenced him to imprisonment for 7 years
imprisonment_type.reason: Life applies only to s.302; the s.376 sentence was reduced to 7 years, which is omitted.

imprisonment_years.quote: for the offence under Section 376 of IPC, the High Court sentenced him to imprisonment for 7 years
imprisonment_years.reason: Judgment states a 7-year term, so null is contradicted.

fine_rs.quote: along with a fine of Rs.1,000/-, in default, to further undergo imprisonment for 1 (one) month
fine_rs.reason: Judgment states fines of Rs.1,000 (High Court) and Rs.10,000 (trial), contrary to null.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Victim went to field near embankment to attend goats; father found her dead; eyewitness PW-1 said he saw accused and accomplice commit rape and murder; medical evidence showed asphyxia by throttling; seized underwear was suspected to be stained with semen
neutral_facts.quote: The accused was also found to have possessed items that were later linked to the crime.
neutral_facts.reason: Claims items were linked to crime, which the judgment only describes as suspected; also presents the eyewitness account as established fact.

offence_severity.reason: Reflects the trial court's death sentence and life imprisonment for the offences.

attempt_completion.reason: Victim died, so the offences were completed.

physical_harm.reason: Matches PW-9's listed injuries including chin cut, neck bruises, trachea fracture and asphyxia.

number_of_offences.reason: Two offences (rape and murder) charged, and conviction under both counts upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property loss is discussed, so the value is consistent with the judgment.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation or planning is not discussed in the judgment.

motive.reason: Motive is not stated in the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the headnote and para 11 on acceptance of PW-1, PW-2 and PW-9 evidence.

witness_credibility.reason: Matches the courts' finding that there was no reason to disbelieve PW-1 and PW-2.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused came out of farm house, enquired about victim, and came to see the dead body after about two hours
post_offence_conduct.quote: The appellant-accused also came and enquired.
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment describes accused's conduct after the incident, contrary to 'Not stated'.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated.

trial_duration.reason: Listed dates match the judgment: offence 29.03.2000, trial 18.03.2006, High Court 26.09.2006, Supreme Court 03.05.2013.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.reason: Case registered, charge-sheet filed, and trial completed as described.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is recorded in the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the State's submission on PW-1's reliability and corroboration.

defence_argument.reason: Matches the three contentions recorded by the Court.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the Court's holdings on life imprisonment and cautious remission.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All cited authorities match those relied on in paras 15 and 17.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Trial court imposed death for heinous rape and murder; High Court reduced to life because of accused's age and not 'rarest of rare'

sentencing_rationale.reason: Attributes the final sentence to heinous nature, but the reduction rested on the High Court's age and rarest-of-rare reasoning.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Age of 33 and not rarest-of-rare category were relied on by the High Court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Heinous crime and disposal of body in bushes are identified as aggravating.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Fine of Rs.1,000 with one month default imprisonment (s.302, High Court)
